mkdir "${RR:?}/qdrant-recovery" && python3 -c "
import hashlib,json,os,socket,subprocess,sys,time,urllib.request as u
R=sys.argv[1]
s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1];s.close()
cfg=R+'/config.yaml'
open(cfg,'w').write('storage:\n  storage_path: '+R+'/storage\n  snapshots_path: '+R+'/snapshots\nservice:\n  host: 127.0.0.1\n  http_port: '+str(port)+'\n  grpc_port: null\n  enable_cors: false\ncluster:\n  enabled: false\ntelemetry_disabled: true\n')
os.makedirs(R+'/cwd')
log=open(R+'/qdrant.log','w')
p=subprocess.Popen(['qdrant','--config-path',cfg,'--disable-telemetry'],cwd=R+'/cwd',stdout=log,stderr=log)
Q='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)
def call(m,path,body=None):
    q=u.Request(Q+path,method=m,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try:
        with u.urlopen(q,timeout=60) as r: return r.status,json.load(r)
    except u.HTTPError as e: return e.code,json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')
ok=False
try:
    for _ in range(150):
        try:
            if call('GET','/readyz')[0]==200: break
        except Exception: time.sleep(0.2)
    v=call('GET','/')[1]
    pts=[{'id':i+1,'vector':[round((i+1)*0.1,3),round(1-i*0.05,3),round((i%3)*0.25,3),0.5],'payload':{'doc':'nsr-'+str(i),'n':i}} for i in range(8)]
    c=call('PUT','/collections/nsr_recovery',{'vectors':{'size':4,'distance':'Cosine'}})[0]
    up=call('PUT','/collections/nsr_recovery/points?wait=true',{'points':pts})[1]['result']['status']
    def dump():
        d=call('POST','/collections/nsr_recovery/points/scroll',{'limit':100,'with_payload':True,'with_vector':True})[1]
        return sorted((x['id'],tuple(x['vector']),json.dumps(x['payload'],sort_keys=True)) for x in d.get('result',{}).get('points',[]))
    before=dump()
    snap=call('POST','/collections/nsr_recovery/snapshots?wait=true')[1]['result']
    path=R+'/snapshots/nsr_recovery/'+snap['name']
    sha=hashlib.sha256(open(path,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    dele=call('DELETE','/collections/nsr_recovery')[1]['result'];gone=call('GET','/collections/nsr_recovery')[0]
    bad=call('PUT','/collections/nsr_recovery/snapshots/recover?wait=true',{'location':'file://'+path,'checksum':'0'*64})[0];after_bad=call('GET','/collections/nsr_recovery')[0]
    good=call('PUT','/collections/nsr_recovery/snapshots/recover?wait=true',{'location':'file://'+path,'checksum':sha})[0]
    after=dump()
    print('owned qdrant',v.get('version'),v.get('commit','')[:7],'| 8 points upserted',up,'| snapshot sha256',sha[:12],'| collection deleted',dele,'then GET',gone,'| recover with a wrong checksum: HTTP',bad,'then GET',after_bad,'| recover with the snapshot checksum: HTTP',good,'| restored',len(after),'points; ids, vectors and payloads identical to before the loss:',after==before)
    ok=c==200 and up=='completed' and len(before)==8 and dele is True and gone==404 and bad>=400 and after_bad==404 and good==200 and after==before
finally:
    p.terminate()
    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
    except Exception: p.kill()
print('owned qdrant process stopped, exit',p.returncode)
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
" "${RR:?}/qdrant-recovery"
